verdict.rationale: Brex documents automatic receipt matching: an uploaded receipt is matched to existing expenses via the Receipt Match API. Its AI assistants are said to be 'fetching receipts', and a community comment mentions auto-generated receipts. A review agent 'follows up with anyone out of compliance', which roughly covers the nudge, though there is no specific missing-receipt reminder logic. missing for 10: named e-receipt source integrations (e.g. email/vendor connectors) that pull receipts automatically, explicit documentation that nudges fire only when a receipt is genuinely missing, independent hands-on corroboration of match accuracy.
